items.en: Russia is building drone-pilot training into youth policy in occupied Luhansk Oblast, including a Putin-approved championship for children aged 7 to 18

items.en: Finland closes investigation into four armed Ukrainian strike drones that strayed into its territory in spring 2026
items.nl: Finland sluit onderzoek naar vier bewapende Oekraïense aanvalsdrones die in het voorjaar van 2026 op Fins grondgebied belandden
items.sEn: Finland's National Bureau of Investigation and the Finnish Border Guard have completed their inquiry into four incidents in spring 2026 in which Ukrainian military drones crossed into Finnish territory.
